title: Hot Cross Buns
_parts: Each part is a beat grid: one token per beat, '-' for a rest, '|' between bars (ignored). The 'one a penny' bars are stretched from eighths to quarters so nobody has to swing twice a beat.

parts.melody: Mi  Re  Do  -   | Mi  Re  Do  -   | Do  Do  Do  Do  | Re  Re  Re  Re  | Mi  Re  Do  -
parts.harmony: Sol -   -   -   | Sol -   -   -   | Sol -   Sol -   | Ti  -   Ti  -   | Sol -   Sol -

_arrangements: Keyed by number of phones. 'parts' lists which parts are played; each note is rung by whichever phone(s) hold it in 'layout'. Spare gestures hold chord tones (Do/Mi/Sol octaves) so a stray swing still sounds right.
